evidence_text: Synthetic benchmark evidence: for L(w)=(w-3)^2, dL/dw=2(w-3), and one update is w_next=w-eta*dL/dw.

node_description: Trace queue and visited-state changes for a small graph.

item.objective: Trace breadth-first search without replacing the mechanism with a library call
item.acceptance: Show queue and visited states, termination, and one boundary case

evidence_text: Synthetic benchmark evidence: BFS marks a discovered vertex and enqueues it once; vertices leave the queue in first-in-first-out order.

node_title: 闭环制造控制中的反馈

node_description: Connect measurement bias to control action and downstream quality.

item.objective: Explain a bounded sensor-bias fault chain
item.acceptance: Separate measured value, true value, controller action and quality effect without inventing device parameters

evidence_text: Synthetic benchmark evidence: a positive sensor bias makes the measured output exceed the true output and can therefore change the controller command in the wrong direction.

node_description: Relate atomic diffusion, time, temperature and an observable processing outcome.

item.objective: Explain the scale and assumptions behind a diffusion-distance estimate
item.acceptance: State the mechanism, variables, units, assumptions and one limit of the estimate

evidence_text: Synthetic benchmark evidence: a characteristic one-dimensional diffusion distance scales with the square root of diffusivity times time; diffusivity is temperature dependent.

node_description: 从系统边界和符号约定建立单入口单出口稳流能量方程。

evidence_text: Synthetic benchmark evidence: at steady state, the control-volume energy accumulation is zero; heat, work, enthalpy, kinetic energy and potential energy terms must use a consistent sign convention.

preference: Teach intuition first, keep English terms, then substitute a tiny numerical example with units and a limit check.
node_description: Distinguish rate, accumulated quantity and dimensionless efficiency.

item.objective: Distinguish power, energy and efficiency in a bounded conversion example
item.acceptance: Use consistent units, state the time interval and check that efficiency stays within its model boundary

evidence_text: Synthetic benchmark evidence: energy equals power integrated over time; for a constant rate E=P*t, and a bounded classroom efficiency is useful output divided by supplied input.
